struct Applications
  virtual AgentUpdateResult find_agent_update(const AgentUpdateRequest& request)
  virtual AgentUpdateResult prepare_agent_update(const AgentUpdateRequest& request)
  virtual AgentUpdateResult commit_agent_update(const std::string& intent)
  virtual::abstraction::facade::ApplicationChange set_activation(const ActivationConfiguration& request)
  virtual::abstraction::facade::ApplicationChange reconcile_activation(const::abstraction::facade::ApplicationDescriptor& expected)
  virtual::abstraction::facade::ApplicationChange confirm_receiver_start(const std::string& recipe_digest)
  virtual AgentEnrollmentResult read_agent_enrollment(const std::string& application)
  virtual AgentEnrollmentResult set_agent_enrollment(const AgentEnrollmentRequest& request)
  virtual Change register_(const RegisterRequest& request)
  virtual::abstraction::facade::ApplicationChange ask_confirmation(const std::string& application)
  virtual Change remove(const ChangeRequest& request)
  virtual::abstraction::facade::ApplicationChange announce(const std::string& key, const::abstraction::facade::ApplicationPresence& presence)
  virtual::abstraction::facade::ApplicationChange withdraw(const std::string& application, const std::string& instance)
  virtual Page observe(const Query& query)
  virtual ActivationResult activate(const std::string& key, const ActivateRequest& request)
  virtual DescribeResult describe(const::abstraction::facade::appmodel::ApplicationsQuery& query)
  virtual OpenResult open(const std::string& key, const OpenRequest& request)
  virtual DescribeResult describe_open(const::abstraction::facade::appmodel::OpenHandleQuery& query)
  virtual CommandsResult commands(const::abstraction::facade::appmodel::CommandsQuery& query)
  virtual CallResult call(const std::string& key, const::abstraction::facade::appmodel::GatewayCall& call)
  virtual SignInStartResult read_sign_in_start()
  virtual SetupResult request_setup(const std::string& use)
  virtual SetupRequestRead receive_setup_request(const std::string& after)
  virtual SetupStepReport report_setup_step(const SetupPresenterReceipt& receipt)
